auth.name: Sign-in and accounts
auth.summary: Let people create an account and sign in to your app.
auth.description: Adds sign-up, sign-in and sign-out pages, and keeps a list of the people who have an account. Passwords are stored safely. People can download their data or delete their account from their profile page. Features that need people to be signed in, like favorites or private messages, use these accounts automatically.

food-truck-finder.name: Food Truck Finder
food-truck-finder.summary: Help people find food trucks near them, with a live map.
food-truck-finder.description: Everything a food truck app needs. Truck owners sign up, put their truck on the map, keep their menu up to date and post deals. Customers see trucks near them on a map, read reviews and grab deals. Includes its own sign-up and sign-in.

contact-form.name: Contact Form
contact-form.summary: Let visitors send you a message.
contact-form.description: A polished contact page with a full-width form that saves submissions to a database. Includes an admin inbox page where you can browse every message.

newsletter.name: Newsletter
newsletter.summary: Collect email addresses for your news and offers.
newsletter.description: A bold signup page with a single email field, a growing subscriber list, and an admin page showing every signup with timestamps.

waitlist.name: Waitlist
waitlist.summary: Let people sign up to hear when you open.
waitlist.description: A bold pre-launch page with a single email field to join the waitlist. Captures name, email and optional referral source. Great for landing pages before you ship.

blog.name: Blog
blog.summary: Write posts and news for your visitors.
blog.description: A blog home page with a list of recent posts, an admin page to publish new posts, and a flow that returns the post feed. Wire up a per-post detail page later by editing in the visual editor.

faq.name: FAQ
faq.summary: Answer the questions people ask most.
faq.description: A question-and-answer page grouped by category. Comes with an admin form to add new Q&A items and a public feed that lists everything published.

kb.name: Knowledge Base
kb.summary: Publish help articles your customers can search.
kb.description: A help center with categorized articles. Includes a public article list and a simple admin page to publish new articles.

timeline.name: Timeline
timeline.summary: Show your story as a list of dates and milestones.
timeline.description: A changelog-style vertical timeline. Perfect for release notes, company history, project milestones or any list of dated events.

portfolio.name: Portfolio
portfolio.description: A project portfolio with title, image, description and optional external link. Great for designers, developers, photographers and agencies.

testimonials.name: Testimonials
testimonials.summary: Show what happy customers say about you.
testimonials.description: Collect and display customer quotes. Simpler than a review system — no rating stars, just name, photo and the quote text. Perfect to drop into a landing page.

guestbook.name: Guestbook
guestbook.summary: Let visitors leave you a friendly note.
guestbook.description: A classic guestbook where visitors leave their name and a short message. Newest first. Perfect for personal sites, memorials and event pages.

shop.name: Simple Shop
shop.summary: Sell products online with a real shopping cart.
shop.description: Product listing with a client-side cart. Visitors add items to their basket, review the cart, and submit an order that captures their details, the full cart contents, and the computed total. Orders land in an admin table you can browse.

catalog.name: Product Catalog
catalog.summary: Show your products, without taking payment.
catalog.description: A clean product catalog with name, price, image and description. Great for menus, brochures and showroom-style pages where customers enquire rather than buy online.

menu.name: Restaurant Menu
menu.summary: Show your food and drink menu.
menu.description: A restaurant or cafe menu grouped by category (Starters, Mains, Drinks) with item name, description and price. Admin page lets you add new items from your phone.

pricing.name: Pricing Plans
pricing.summary: Show your prices and let people sign up.
pricing.description: A polished pricing page with three tiers (edit freely in the editor) and an interest form that captures emails for each selected plan.

coupons.name: Coupons
coupons.description: Create discount codes customers can redeem on a public page. Tracks which codes have been used, their discount amount, and the redemption history.

wishlist.name: Wishlist
wishlist.summary: Let people keep a list of things they want.
wishlist.description: A wishlist of products with name, price, store link and optional image. Share it for gift-giving or keep it private for later.

gift-registry.name: Gift Registry
gift-registry.summary: Run a wedding or baby gift list that guests can reserve from.
gift-registry.description: A gift registry where guests can browse items and mark them as reserved. Each item has a name, price, store link and whether it's still available.

subscription.name: Subscription Box
subscription.summary: Let customers sign up for a monthly box or plan.
subscription.description: A sign-up page for a monthly subscription with tier picker, shipping info and confirmation. Stores members in a table to charge and fulfill.

service-menu.name: Service Menu
service-menu.description: A service menu like a salon or spa — each service has a name, duration, price and description. Perfect next to a booking page.

quote-request.name: Quote Request
quote-request.summary: Let customers ask you for a quote.
quote-request.description: A request-a-quote form for service businesses. Capture project details, budget and timeline. Admin sees all requests with a status column for triage.

bookings.name: Bookings
bookings.summary: Let people book a time with you.
bookings.description: A booking page where customers pick a date and time, add their details, and submit a reservation. Double-booking protection checks for an existing booking at the requested slot before accepting. Backed by a bookings table and an admin page to browse upcoming slots.

appointments.name: Appointments
appointments.summary: Let customers book an appointment with a member of your team.
appointments.description: Structured appointments: a list of services with duration and price, assigned to providers, and customers book a specific slot. More flexible than Bookings — great for salons, clinics, and consultancies.

invoice.name: Invoices
invoice.summary: Send invoices and keep track of who has paid.
invoice.description: Create customer invoices with amount, due date and status. See which ones are paid, pending or overdue from a single admin page.

expenses.name: Expenses
expenses.summary: Keep track of what your business spends.
expenses.description: Log business expenses with date, category, amount and notes. Browse everything in one list for easy monthly review and tax prep.

properties.name: Real Estate Listings
properties.summary: List homes and properties for sale or rent.
properties.description: A real estate listings page with photos, price, beds, baths, square footage and address. Plus an inquiry form so interested buyers can reach out.

rentals.name: Vacation Rentals
rentals.summary: List holiday rentals people can ask to book.
rentals.description: Airbnb-style short-term rental listings. Each has photos, nightly price, sleeps count, amenities and a booking request form.

stripe-checkout.name: Online payments
stripe-checkout.summary: Take card payments for anything you sell.
stripe-checkout.description: A product page with a Checkout button that creates a real Stripe Checkout session and redirects the customer to pay. Bring your own Stripe secret key in the module config.

stripeSecret.label: Stripe secret key
stripeSecret.help: Your Stripe secret key. Use a test key to start.

successUrl.label: Success redirect URL
successUrl.help: Where people land after they pay: a page of your app, like its thank-you page. Copy the address from your app's Publish tab.

cancelUrl.label: Cancel redirect URL
cancelUrl.help: Where people land if they cancel: usually your app's home page.

chat.name: Community Chat
chat.summary: Give your community a shared chat room.
chat.description: A single shared chatroom where visitors post messages. Posts appear newest-first, backed by a chat_messages table and a send/list flow pair. Perfect for early community feedback or waitlist chatter.

realtime-chat.name: Real-time Chat
realtime-chat.summary: A chat room where messages appear instantly.
realtime-chat.description: A public chatroom that polls for new messages every few seconds so conversations feel instant. Drop it anywhere you want visitors to talk in real time.

fanwall.name: Fanwall
fanwall.summary: Let your community post on a shared wall.
fanwall.description: A single-thread public wall where visitors post short messages with their name and an optional image. Newest first. Similar to a Twitter/Facebook wall but without accounts.

forum.name: Forum
forum.summary: Let people start discussions and reply to each other.
forum.description: A community forum with topics and real replies. Visitors start a topic from the forum home, click through to a detail page, and post replies. Reply counts update automatically on each reply.

reviews.name: Reviews
reviews.summary: Collect star ratings and reviews from customers.
reviews.description: A review submission page with a star rating and comment, plus a public page that lists every approved review. Perfect for adding social proof to your site.

classifieds.name: Classifieds
classifieds.summary: Let people post their own listings.
classifieds.description: A Craigslist-style classifieds board. Visitors post listings with title, price and contact info; a feed page shows everything active.

jobs.name: Jobs Board
jobs.summary: Post job openings and receive applications.
jobs.description: A careers page with open roles and an apply form. Candidates submit name, email, resume link and a cover message; applications land in a table you can review in the admin.

team.name: Team Directory
team.summary: Introduce the people on your team.
team.description: A staff directory with photo, name, role and short bio. Perfect for about pages and internal intranets.

polls.name: Polls
polls.summary: Ask a question and let people vote.
polls.description: A poll module: create a question with a list of options, visitors vote, results update live. Great for quick community decisions.

petitions.name: Petition
petitions.description: A petition page with a title, description and signature form. Tracks signers by name, email and optional comment; shows a signature count.

feature-voting.name: Feature Voting
feature-voting.summary: Let people suggest ideas and vote for their favorites.
feature-voting.description: Public feature request board where users post ideas and upvote others. Product teams use it to prioritize what to build next.

push-notifications.name: Push Notifications
push-notifications.summary: Send alerts to people's phones and computers.
push-notifications.description: Add a 'Turn on notifications' button. Visitors opt in from their browser (or, on iPhone, from the app added to their home screen), and you send them updates from the app's Notifications screen or from a workflow.

events.name: Events Calendar
events.summary: Show upcoming events and let people say they're coming.
events.description: List upcoming events with date, location and description. Visitors can RSVP with their name and email; RSVPs are saved to a table for the admin to review.

survey.name: Survey
survey.summary: Ask customers a few questions and collect their answers.
survey.description: A survey with multiple questions and free-text answers. Store responses as a JSON blob per submission and browse them in the admin.

quiz.name: Quiz
quiz.summary: Run a fun quiz with scores.
quiz.description: A single-page quiz with multiple questions. Each submission is stored with the user's name, their answers and a score you can compute client-side or in a flow.

todo.name: Todo List
todo.summary: Keep a to-do list and tick things off.
todo.description: A personal or shared todo list with title, notes, priority and done state. Backed by a real tasks table you can query, filter and build on.

habits.name: Habit Tracker
habits.summary: Track daily habits and build streaks.
habits.description: Track daily habits with a name, current streak and last-checked date. Check in every day to grow your streak.

journal.name: Journal
journal.summary: Keep a daily journal with a mood for each day.
journal.description: A private daily journal with mood selector, tags and free-form entry. Browse past entries chronologically.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Jot down short notes with tags. Great for capturing ideas, links, reminders and scraps that don't belong in a full document.

reading.name: Reading List
reading.summary: Keep track of books to read, being read, and finished.
reading.description: Your personal book tracker. Each book has a title, author, cover, status and an optional rating once you finish it.

kanban.name: Task board
kanban.summary: Move tasks across a board from to-do to done.
kanban.description: A Kanban board with To Do, In Progress and Done columns. Cards have title, description and priority. Move them by updating the column.

leads.name: Customer leads
leads.summary: Keep track of possible customers and follow them up.
leads.description: A lightweight CRM: capture leads with name, company, email and stage. Visualize your pipeline by stage and know who to follow up with.

help-desk.name: Help Desk
help-desk.summary: Receive and answer customer support requests.
help-desk.description: Customer submits a support ticket with subject, description and priority. You triage and resolve from an admin ticket list.

budget.name: Personal Budget
budget.summary: Keep track of money coming in and going out.
budget.description: A simple personal budget: log income and expenses by category, see recent transactions and build toward knowing where your money goes.

chores.name: Chore Chart
chores.summary: Share out household chores, with rewards.
chores.description: A family chore chart: assign chores to kids, mark them done, earn stars. Turn everyday tasks into a visible, rewardable routine.

wedding.name: Wedding RSVP
wedding.summary: A wedding page where guests can reply to your invitation.
wedding.description: A beautiful wedding landing page with date, venue, story and an RSVP form that captures guest name, attending status, meal choice and plus-one.

password-vault.name: Password Vault
password-vault.summary: Keep private notes safe behind a PIN.
password-vault.description: A simple vault for storing shared secrets (wifi passwords, license keys, door codes). Protected by a master PIN stored as an argon2 hash — never in plaintext.

masterPin.label: Master PIN
masterPin.help: Stored as an argon2 hash. Never recoverable.

gallery.name: Photo Gallery
gallery.description: A responsive image gallery with title, caption and image URL per item. Comes with an upload page for adding new photos by URL.

audio.name: Audio Playlist
audio.summary: Share a playlist of songs or recordings.
audio.description: A playlist page that lists audio tracks with title, artist and a streaming URL. Each track gets an HTML5 audio player so visitors can preview directly.

video.name: Video Library
video.summary: Show your videos from YouTube or Vimeo.
video.description: A video gallery that embeds YouTube and Vimeo videos. Visitors see the thumbnail grid; clicking opens the player inline. Edit each video's title and description in the admin.

radio.name: Radio Player
radio.description: A radio page with a big play button, a station directory the listener can switch between live, and a song-request form. Starts with one station seeded from your config and grows as you add more from the admin page.

podcast.name: Podcast
podcast.summary: Share podcast episodes people can listen to.
podcast.description: A podcast landing page with episodes list, each with a title, description, duration and audio URL. Visitors can play episodes right on the page.

recipes.name: Recipes
recipes.summary: Share recipes with ingredients and steps.
recipes.description: A collection of recipes. Each has a title, cover image, ingredient list, instructions, prep time and serving count. Perfect for home cooks or a food blog.

course.name: Online Course
course.summary: Teach an online course, lesson by lesson.
course.description: A mini e-learning platform: sequenced lessons, each with a title, description, video URL and optional duration. Great for micro-courses and tutorials.

ai-assistant.name: Chat helper
ai-assistant.summary: Let visitors chat with a helpful assistant.
ai-assistant.description: Add an AI question box to your site. Visitors ask a question, the AI answers using instructions you set, and the answer appears right under the form. Every question and answer is saved on a private page that only you can open.

disclosure.label: Note shown under the heading
disclosure.help: Tells visitors they're talking to an AI.

links.name: Link Directory
links.summary: Share a simple page of your important links.
links.description: A simple curated list of external links with title, icon and description. Perfect for Linktree-style pages, curated resource lists or link-in-bio apps.

places.name: Places
places.summary: A guide to places on a map, with photos and nearest first.
places.description: A phone-friendly guide to places: a list, categories and a map with photo pins. Visitors search, share their location to see the nearest places first, and open a place for photos, opening hours, a call button and directions. Signed-in visitors can suggest their own venue, which waits for your approval. Comes in five languages, with ready-made examples for a tourist guide, restaurants, a business directory or wedding and event venues.

preset.label: Use for
preset.help: Sets the categories, the wording and the example places it starts with. You can change all of them afterwards.

title.label: Guide title
title.help: Shown at the top of the guide. Leave it empty to use a title that fits what it's for, in each visitor's language.

languages.label: Languages
languages.help: Visitors switch with the globe button. Their phone's language is used when it's offered, otherwise the first one. Place names and descriptions show as you wrote them.

sortBy.label: Order of the list
sortBy.help: When a visitor shares their location, the nearest places always come first.

options.featured: Featured places first, then your order
options.name: A to Z

accent.label: Colour
accent.help: The colour of the guide's header, buttons and map pins. Text and backgrounds always follow your app's theme.

emergency-contacts.name: Emergency Contacts
emergency-contacts.summary: Keep important phone numbers one tap away.
emergency-contacts.description: A list of emergency contacts with name, relationship and phone. Tap-to-call on mobile. Great for schools, camps, office front desks and families.

weather.name: Weather Widget
weather.description: Fetch live weather for a location using an OpenWeatherMap API key. Shows temperature, conditions and an icon. Bring your own free API key in the module config.

map.name: Map & Locator
map.summary: Show your locations on a map.
map.description: A real interactive map powered by Leaflet and OpenStreetMap. Shows your business location with a pin and address. Free — no API key required.

link-tracker.name: Link clicks
link-tracker.summary: See how many people click your links.
link-tracker.description: Create trackable links for your marketing campaigns. Each click is logged with a timestamp so you can see which channels drive the most traffic.

file-upload.name: File Upload
file-upload.description: Let visitors upload files with a drag-and-drop form. Files land in a per-project storage directory and the URL is saved in a table you can browse.

qr-scanner.name: QR Scanner
qr-scanner.summary: Scan QR codes with a phone camera.
qr-scanner.description: A camera-based QR code scanner powered by jsQR. Scans land in a form field you can submit — perfect for check-ins, coupons and attendance.

user-favorites.name: Favorites
user-favorites.summary: Let signed-in people save their favorite items.
user-favorites.description: Lets logged-in users favorite anything (a product, a truck, a post, an article) and browse their personal list. Uses whatever auth module is already installed in the project — you must install Auth / Accounts (or another auth-session provider) first.

user-profile-card.name: Profile card
user-profile-card.summary: Show each signed-in person their own profile.
user-profile-card.description: A small profile card that shows the logged-in user's name, avatar and bio. Uses whichever auth-users module is installed — no database of its own. Drop it on a page to give visitors a quick sense of who's signed in.

donations.name: Donations
donations.summary: Raise money for a goal and thank your donors.
donations.description: A donation page with a cause description, progress bar toward your goal, and a public donor wall. Collects donor name, email, amount and an optional message. Payment integration is handled by a separate Stripe module.

lost-found.name: Lost & Found
lost-found.summary: Let your community report lost and found items.
lost-found.description: A community lost and found. People report items they lost or found with location and contact info. The board shows everything in one place so people can match them up.

loyalty-card.name: Loyalty Punch Card
loyalty-card.summary: Reward regulars with a digital stamp card.
loyalty-card.description: A digital punch card for your shop. Customers give their phone number at the counter, you punch their card, and when they reach the goal they get a free item. Tracks every customer and every punch.

e-signature.name: E-Signature
e-signature.summary: Send a document and get it signed online.
e-signature.description: Send any text-based document (terms, NDA, quote) to a recipient by email, and let them sign it in-browser with a drawn signature. Stores the signed signature image, the signer's name + IP, and a signed-at timestamp.

email-verify.name: Email check
email-verify.summary: Check that people's email addresses are real.
email-verify.description: Issue a 6-digit verification code by email, store it with a short expiry, and verify it on the user's next request. Pairs naturally with the auth module: marks the user as email_verified once they confirm.

two-factor.name: Extra sign-in check
two-factor.summary: Add a code sent by email when people sign in.
two-factor.description: Adds an extra step to login: after the user signs in, we email them a 6-digit code. Until they confirm it, their session is flagged unverified. Drop this in any project that uses the auth module to harden account access.

inbox.name: Private Inbox
inbox.summary: Let members send each other private messages.
inbox.description: 1-to-1 private messaging between signed-in users. Pick a recipient, send messages, see read/unread state per conversation. Conversations are deduplicated by sender+recipient pair.

referrals.name: Referrals
referrals.summary: Reward people who invite their friends.
referrals.description: Each user gets a unique referral code and a share URL. When someone signs up using that code, we log a conversion against the referrer. Includes a leaderboard of top referrers and a 'my code' page for sharing.

reminders.name: Reminders
reminders.summary: Send email reminders at a time you choose.
reminders.description: Let users (or admins) schedule a reminder: 'email me X at 4pm Friday.' Reminders are stored with a due-at time and an email body; a separate worker (or manual 'send due now' flow) fires them when they're due.

tags.name: Labels
tags.summary: Add labels to things so they're easy to sort and find.
tags.description: A simple tagging system. Define tags (with optional color), then attach them to any row in any table via a polymorphic tagging table (entity_table + entity_id). Useful for categorizing leads, projects, or content.

analytics-dashboard.name: Visitor stats
analytics-dashboard.summary: See how many people visit your pages.
analytics-dashboard.description: Track page views and arbitrary custom events ('signup', 'purchase'). Includes a beacon endpoint to call from any page, a counters API, and an admin dashboard with totals, top pages, and a 7-day trend.

webhooks-in.name: Receive data from other apps
webhooks-in.summary: Receive information sent from other apps and services.
webhooks-in.description: Expose a public webhook URL that captures any JSON payload from external services (Stripe events, GitHub hooks, Zapier, etc.) into a table. Browse and re-process payloads from the admin dashboard.

sms.name: Text messages
sms.summary: Send text messages to your customers.
sms.description: Send SMS messages to a phone number via Twilio's REST API. Stores every send in an outbox table for audit. Pair with reminders, two-factor, or any flow that wants to text instead of email.

marketplace.name: Marketplace
marketplace.summary: Let other sellers sell through your shop.
marketplace.description: Turn a single-vendor shop into a multi-vendor marketplace. Sellers sign up, list products under their store, and an admin sees orders + commissions across all stores. Each product is owned by a seller, with an automatic commission split.

inventory.name: Inventory
inventory.summary: Keep track of stock and know when it's running low.
inventory.description: Track stock per SKU. Adjust quantities (receive new stock, log a sale, manual adjustment), see what's low, and download a CSV. Pairs with the shop module to keep your storefront's stock honest.

e-wallet.name: Store credit
e-wallet.summary: Give customers store credit they can top up and spend.
e-wallet.description: Give each user a credit balance. Add credits (top-up), spend credits (deduct), and view a full ledger of every transaction. Other modules can spend on behalf of the signed-in user via the spend flow.

event-tickets.name: Event Tickets
event-tickets.summary: Sell tickets and check them at the door.
event-tickets.description: Sell tickets for an event with multiple tiers (General, VIP, etc). Each issued ticket gets a unique code; render it as a QR for the holder. At the door, scan the QR to validate and mark the ticket as used.

queue.name: Virtual Queue
queue.summary: Let customers join a line without standing in it.
queue.description: A virtual waiting line. Customers join the queue from their phone, see their number and a live position counter. Staff page calls 'next' to advance, and the now-serving number broadcasts to all waiting visitors.

gym.name: Gym / Membership
gym.description: A small gym or studio toolkit: membership plans (Monthly, 10-pack), class schedule with capacity, and a check-in flow that scans a member to log entry. Owner sees today's attendance and current active members.

delivery-tracking.name: Delivery Tracking
delivery-tracking.description: Track a delivery from pickup to dropoff. Drivers post lat/lng pings; customers see the latest pin on a map and a status timeline (assigned → picked up → on the way → delivered). Each delivery has a public tracking link.

whatsapp-order.name: WhatsApp Order
whatsapp-order.summary: Let customers send you orders on WhatsApp.
whatsapp-order.description: Let customers build a small cart on a public page, then 'order via WhatsApp' opens a chat with your business with the whole order pre-typed. Orders are also logged server-side so you have a record beyond the WhatsApp thread.

whatsappNumber.label: WhatsApp number (digits only, with country code)

phonebook.name: Phonebook / Directory
phonebook.summary: A contact list people can search.
phonebook.description: A searchable staff or member directory. Each entry has a photo, name, title, department, email, phone, and a short bio. Filter by department, search by name. Great for company intranets, school staff pages, or chamber-of-commerce member lists.

claims.name: Claims & Receipts
claims.summary: Let people send a claim with a photo and follow its progress.
claims.description: Customers (or employees) submit a claim or receipt with a description, amount and a photo URL. Staff move it through a status workflow (received → reviewing → approved/rejected) and post a public reply. Great for warranty claims, expense reimbursements, or insurance receipts.

slider.name: Image Slider
slider.summary: Show pictures that slide by one after another.
slider.description: A homepage hero carousel that an admin can edit without touching code. Add slides (image, headline, subhead, CTA button + link), reorder, and the public carousel autoplays. Built with vanilla JS — no carousel library dependency.

before-after.name: Before / After Slider
before-after.summary: Compare two photos side by side with a slider.
before-after.description: Show off transformations. Each comparison has a 'before' and 'after' image; visitors drag a divider to wipe between them. Admin can add as many comparisons as they want. Great for renovations, fitness, hair, photo edits.

pdf-embed.name: PDF Library
pdf-embed.summary: Share documents people can read on the page.
pdf-embed.description: Maintain a small library of PDF documents (price lists, brochures, manuals, contracts). Each PDF gets a public viewer page with the browser's built-in PDF renderer embedded. Visitors can open them inline or download.

status-page.name: Status Page
status-page.summary: Tell customers whether everything is running normally.
status-page.description: A status page like statuspage.io. Define a list of services (API, Web, Database…), each with a current status indicator. Post incidents that progress through investigating → identified → resolved, with public updates pinned to the affected services.

routes.name: Routes & Itineraries
routes.summary: Share a route or trip plan, stop by stop.
routes.description: Build a multi-stop itinerary or route: add stops in order (name, address, lat/lng, notes), see them on a map with a connecting polyline, and share the finished route publicly via a clean printable page.

birthdays.name: Birthdays
birthdays.summary: Wish your customers a happy birthday.
birthdays.description: Collect users' birthdays, then auto-email anyone whose birthday is today. Useful for customer love (a 'happy birthday' note + discount code) or for team/HR pages. Pair with a daily cron pointing at /api/run/send-today.

scratch-card.name: Scratch Card
scratch-card.summary: Give out prizes with a scratch-to-win card.
scratch-card.description: A scratch-off promo. Visitors enter their email, get a virtual scratch card; scratching reveals a random prize from your prize pool (weighted by stock). Each prize awarded is logged with the winner's email and code to claim it.

paywall.name: Paywall
paywall.summary: Keep some pages for paying members or people with a code.
paywall.description: Lock premium content behind an access code or signed-in account. Define unlock codes (single-use or shared), and any page tagged data-nk-paywall is hidden until the visitor enters a valid code or signs in. Unlocks are remembered in localStorage for the visitor.

archive.name: Content Archive
archive.summary: Keep older content searchable by year.
archive.description: Long-term archive for finished projects, old posts, decommissioned products — anything you want to keep around but not show in active feeds. Browse by year/month, full-text search across title + body. A 'restore to main feed' flag is reserved for downstream modules.

share-app.name: Share App
share-app.summary: Make it easy for people to share your app.
share-app.description: A drop-in 'Share this app' page with native Web Share API (mobile), copy-to-clipboard, and pre-built share links for Twitter/X, Facebook, WhatsApp, Email and LinkedIn. Tracks every share by destination so you can see which channels work.

reactions.name: Reactions
reactions.summary: Let people react to posts with a quick emoji.
reactions.description: A polymorphic reactions system. Any row in any table can have emoji reactions attached (     …). Each reaction is one row referencing (entity_table, entity_id, emoji, optional user_id). Fanwall, forum, blog, gallery — any module can opt in.

scheduled-content.name: Scheduled Content
scheduled-content.description: Write content (title + body) in draft, set a publish_at timestamp, and it appears on the public feed only after that time. A 'publish-due' flow can be cron-pinged to physically flip drafts to live; the public feed also filters in real time.

drip-content.name: Drip Content
drip-content.summary: Release lessons a few days apart.
drip-content.description: Build a sequence of lessons that unlock per-user based on how many days since they enrolled. Lesson 1 unlocks day 0, lesson 2 unlocks day 3, etc. Great for onboarding, training courses, and email drips that pair with the email module.

acknowledgments.name: Acknowledgments
acknowledgments.summary: Make sure people have read important messages.
acknowledgments.description: Publish a message (policy update, terms change, safety notice) that every visitor must explicitly acknowledge to dismiss. Each acknowledgment is logged with timestamp and (optional) user_id for audit. Admin sees real-time compliance counts.

leaderboard.name: Leaderboard
leaderboard.summary: Show a ranking of top scores.
leaderboard.description: A generic leaderboard. Add scores against a user_label (any string — email, name, gym member, employee), the leaderboard ranks descending. Filter by category to maintain multiple boards (steps, sales, points). Submit-score endpoint can be called from any other module.

dynamic-list.name: Custom list
dynamic-list.summary: Make your own list of anything, with a page to edit it.
dynamic-list.description: A mini-CMS: admin defines a 'list' (with a name and a JSON schema of fields), then adds rows through a generated form. Each list gets a public read page and an admin edit page. The 'make your own module' module — perfect when nothing else fits.

countdown.name: Countdown Timer
countdown.summary: Count down to a launch, sale or event.
countdown.description: A live-updating countdown timer page targeting a future timestamp. Renders days/hours/minutes/seconds in a big hero, with optional headline, subhead, and post-zero CTA. Multiple campaigns can run in parallel; pick one with ?id=...

webview.name: Show another website
webview.summary: Show another website inside your app.
webview.description: A simple wrapper that embeds an external URL inside your app via a sandboxed iframe. Useful for embedding existing docs, dashboards, or third-party apps that don't have a native module yet. Configurable per page; supports allowlisted-only sources for safety.

rss-reader.name: News feed reader
rss-reader.summary: Show the latest posts from another website's news feed.
rss-reader.description: Subscribe to one or more external RSS / Atom feeds and display the merged latest items inside your app. A refresh flow fetches feeds (cron-friendly), parses items, and stores them locally so the reader stays snappy.

geofencer.name: Location alerts
geofencer.summary: Show something special when people arrive at a place.
geofencer.description: Define circular geofences (center lat/lng + radius). Visitors share their location; if they're inside a fence, the matching content/message shows. Logs every check-in so you can see hot zones. Pairs nicely with push-notifications or coupons.

personalized-dashboard.name: Personalized Dashboard
personalized-dashboard.summary: Give each signed-in person their own home page.
personalized-dashboard.description: A personalized home page that greets the signed-in user by name and shows widgets they've pinned. Pin a widget (label + URL + icon) and it appears on your dashboard. Other modules can also auto-pin widgets (e.g. 'your unread inbox count') via the create-widget flow.

table-reservations.name: Table Reservations
table-reservations.summary: Let guests book a table at your restaurant.
table-reservations.description: Restaurant-specific table booking (distinct from generic appointments). Define your tables (with seats), accept reservations for a date+time+party size, prevent double-booking. Host sees today's grid; diners get a confirmation page.

member-id-card.name: Member ID Card
member-id-card.summary: Give members a digital ID card.
member-id-card.description: Issue digital ID cards to members. Each card has a name, photo, unique member number, tier, issue/expiry date, and a scannable barcode (Code 128). Members open their card on a phone; staff scan it at the door to verify (uses the barcode/QR module's flow).

media-playlist.name: Media Playlist
media-playlist.summary: Put songs and videos together in one playlist.
media-playlist.description: An admin-curated playlist combining audio and video items, played through a single unified player. The player auto-advances to the next item, supports skip / replay, and shows a queue panel with thumbnails.

calculator-builder.name: Calculator Builder
calculator-builder.summary: Add a calculator, like a price or loan estimate.
calculator-builder.description: Build mini calculators with custom inputs and a formula (e.g. mortgage payment, BMI, savings projection, tip splitter, currency converter). Each calculator has a unique slug; embed it anywhere via /calc?slug=…

business-card-wallet.name: Business Card Wallet
business-card-wallet.summary: Share and save digital business cards.
business-card-wallet.description: Each user has a digital business card (name, title, company, contact, photo) plus a wallet of cards they've saved from others. Share your card via QR; recipients can scan and one-tap save to their wallet (and export as a vCard file for their phone's address book).

nutrition-tracker.name: Nutrition Tracker
nutrition-tracker.description: Log meals with calories, protein, carbs, and fat. See daily totals against your goals and a 7-day history chart. Common foods are pre-seeded for quick logging. Pair with habit-tracker for streaks.

project-portfolio.name: Project Portfolio
project-portfolio.summary: Track your projects and how far along they are.
project-portfolio.description: Portfolio view across multiple projects. Each project has a name, owner, status (planned/active/blocked/done), % complete, due date, and a tasks count. Use it to run a small team or freelance pipeline. Distinct from the single-board kanban module.

purchase-order.name: Purchase orders
purchase-order.summary: Request, approve and track orders from suppliers.
purchase-order.description: A lightweight B2B purchase order workflow. Employees submit a PO (vendor, line items, total, justification); approvers see a queue and approve/reject; finance marks fulfilled & paid. Each PO gets a sequential number for accounting reference.

app-walkthrough.name: App Walkthrough
app-walkthrough.summary: Show new visitors a short tour of your app.
app-walkthrough.description: An overlay that walks brand-new visitors through your app on first load. Define ordered steps (title, body, target selector); the overlay highlights each element with a spotlight and 'Next / Skip' controls. Skip state persists per browser so returning visitors aren't bothered.

abandoned-cart.name: Abandoned Cart Recovery
abandoned-cart.summary: Remind shoppers who left items in their cart.
abandoned-cart.description: Capture cart state when a visitor adds items but leaves before checkout. A reminder flow emails them an hour later with a one-click 'resume cart' link. Per-cart token-based recovery URL; logs whether they came back.

submissions-queue.name: Submissions Queue
submissions-queue.summary: Collect submissions and approve them before they go live.
submissions-queue.description: A Reddit-style submission flow: visitors submit content (title + body + optional image), it lands in a moderation queue, an admin approves/rejects, only approved items appear on the public feed. Tracks rejection reasons. Distinct from contact-form which is just an inbox.

store-locator.name: Store Locator
store-locator.summary: Help people find your nearest shop.
store-locator.description: Multi-location store finder with hours, services, distance-sort from the user's location, and a one-tap 'directions' link to Google/Apple Maps. Distinct from generic `places` — purpose-built for retail chains, franchises, branches, and partner locations.

delivery-zones.name: Delivery Zones
delivery-zones.summary: Set delivery prices for different areas.
delivery-zones.description: Define delivery zones by postal code or distance from your shop. Each zone has its own delivery fee and minimum-order requirement. A 'quote' flow accepts an address (or postal code) and returns whether delivery is available and the cost.

live-stream.name: Live Stream
live-stream.description: Host a live stream page that embeds an HLS .m3u8, a YouTube Live URL, or a Twitch channel, with a live chat sidebar (polling the realtime-chat flow). Admin sets the stream type + URL; viewers see the player + chat.

channel-feed.name: Video channel feed
channel-feed.summary: Show the latest videos from your YouTube or Vimeo channel.
channel-feed.description: Subscribe to a YouTube or Vimeo channel feed and auto-display the latest videos in a grid. Refresh flow polls the channel's RSS endpoint; cached items stay snappy. Click a video to open it in an embedded player.

in-app-ads.name: Banner ads
in-app-ads.summary: Show your own banner ads and see who clicks.
in-app-ads.description: Rotate house banner ads on your pages without an external ad network. Admin uploads creatives (image + headline + click URL + active dates), the runtime picks one weighted at random per page view, and every impression + click is logged for CTR analysis. Drop the snippet anywhere.

user-groups.name: Member groups
user-groups.summary: Put members into groups, like VIP or staff.
user-groups.description: Add multi-group membership on top of the auth module's single role field. Define groups (Premium, Beta, VIP, Staff…) and attach any user to one or more. Other modules can check membership via the in-group flow before gating a feature.
